physical.finish: Black or Glacier White chassis, black plastic fingers

base.description: The manager as Chatsworth ships it in black, door fitted.

black.description: 35431-703 - Motive horizontal cable manager, 3U, with cable pass-through ports, black chassis, black fingers.

glacier-white.description: 35431-E03 - the same manager in a Glacier White chassis; the fingers stay black.

description: 3U Motive horizontal cable manager with cable pass-through ports, black fingers, Chatsworth Products 35431-X03 (35431-703 black, 35431-E03 Glacier White chassis): a back plate the full 19 in EIA width that bolts to the rack rails and stands 208 mm out, with a row of ten plastic T-shaped cable guides (fingers) along its top and along its bottom, nine slots in each a cable is laid in through, and a contoured snap-on front door that closes the manager and opens up or down. Two oval ports in the back plate lead cables to the other side.

gaps.note: the maker says the door "opens up or down"; the format has no hinge, so the door is drawn as one fitted plate the drawing can take off to show the fingers (the Evolution door is described as removable; no held Motive page says this one is), and the swing is not stated.
gaps.wanted: a format that can say a hinged cover, and a close picture of the door's edge

gaps.note: no held page says how a Motive horizontal manager mounts, how many screws it takes or where its holes are; it is drawn as the Evolution horizontal manager is, bolted to the rail face.
gaps.wanted: the Motive horizontal manager installation instructions and a dimensioned rear view

gaps.note: the maker publishes a cable fill table on its site, which is not held, and the data sheet gives no capacity for these parts; none is written.
gaps.wanted: the maker's cable fill table row for the Motive horizontal manager

gaps.note: the whole drawing is that of the Evolution horizontal manager `35441-x03`; the Motive photographs show the same form, but no held page dimensions a Motive part.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the Motive horizontal manager

gaps.note: the page 7 photographs show a logo plate on the door and a groove along its length, and no light centre strip; the drawing is the Evolution part's door, a plate with a light aluminium centre strip, and draws neither the logo plate nor the groove.
gaps.wanted: a close picture or a dimensioned front view of the Motive door

gaps.note: the Glacier White configuration recolours the front only (the back plate and the door are components); the rear, top, bottom and side views are drawn in the black chassis colours, as the Evolution part's are, and no held page shows a Glacier White Motive manager.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of a Glacier White Motive horizontal manager and a format that recolours a view's own drawing

gaps.note: no document dimensions the two ports; their size and position are the Evolution part's, read off one perspective picture. The page 7 photograph of a 35431 part shows an opening with straighter sides than the oval the drawing keeps.

body.description: the back plate with its ears

door.description: the snap-on front door over the finger heads

fingers.description: the two rows of fingers, ten a row, upper row first

name: 35431-x03

attrs.note: datasheet - the chassis colour and the finger colour are the ordering table's (page 7): its group heading "White or Black Cable Manager with Black Fingers" and the note "X= Color; 7 = Black, E= Glacier White". No material, finish process, compliance or environment statement for a horizontal manager is on the held page, and none is written (the material of the back plate is not stated either).

bottom.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: the pictures show the same fingers along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

chassis.note: datasheet - 3U x 19 x 8.2 (208 mm) for 35431-X03 in the data sheet's ordering table (page 7, "H x W x D"). The width is the 482.6 of 19 in EIA, ears included, as a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them. The height is the 133.35 of 3 unit(s) at the EIA-310 1.75 in. The depth is the maker's overall figure as the table prints it, and not a body depth.

color.note: estimated - the chassis is black (7) or Glacier White (E) and the fingers are black on both, as the table's heading says. The black is the photographs' dark grey-black; the Glacier White shade is not given by any document and is drawn a light grey, as the Evolution parts' is.

door.note: datasheet - "Contoured, snap-on front door opens up or down" (data sheet page 7, key features), and "Swing the cover up or down to access cables." The door is its own part, fitted as shipped, so a drawing can take it off and show the fingers; the format has no hinge, so that it swings up or down is a gap.

ears.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: the 16.3 of ear each end is half of the 32.6 between the 450.0 the manager's body is taken to fill (the EIA-310 clear opening between the rails, 17.72 in, to 450) and the 482.6 overall. No document gives the ear width. The ears are the ends of the back plate and are drawn with it, as the rack-face FS parts draw theirs; their mounting holes are not drawn, because the installation instructions give only "two to four" screws for the whole range of heights and no hole position.

fingers.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: T-SHAPED FINGERS, TOP AND BOTTOM, ON THE FRONT ONLY. The data sheet and installation instructions show the plastic T-shaped cable guides along the top edge and the bottom edge of the manager, standing from the back plate to the door (step 1: "the cover snaps onto the ends of the plastic, T-shaped cable guides (fingers)"). Nothing is on the back plate's far side. Ten fingers a row (nine slots counted across the width in the data sheet pictures), 45.0 pitch, a 24.0 slot and a head that leaves an 8.0 neck. The finger plate is 11.4 thick, from the maker's interior width of 2.6 in for the 2U part; for this part the interior width is 4.3 in (109.2 mm), which the 11.4 plates leave to within 1.4 mm. The pitch, slot and head are read off the pictures against the 450.0 between the ears and carry no tolerance.

front.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: the door, fitted. With it off, the two rows of finger heads. The `duct` guide is the 110.55 between the finger plates (133.35 less 2 x 11.4), over the 450.0 between the ears; the cable fill table's interior width for this part is 4.3 in (109.2 mm).

guides.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger plates, run across the rack; finger pitch 45.0 and slot 24.0 as `fingers`.

left.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: the side: the back plate, the two finger plates 11.4 high with the cable space between them, and the door's face and returns at the front. No picture of the maker's is a side elevation; it is built from the front and plan figures.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A DATA SHEET TABLE AND TWO PHOTOGRAPHS. The Motive Cable Management data sheet (MKT-60020-675, 09/24, page 7) states each part's height in rack units, 19 in wide, 8.2 in (208 mm) deep, chassis style, finger colour and shipping weight, and shows a photograph of a 35431 part and of a 35432 part. NO HELD DOCUMENT HOLDS A DIMENSIONED DRAWING of a Motive horizontal manager or says how it is built. The drawing is that of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library): the Motive page prints the same envelope and describes the same parts (a snap-on door that swings up or down, plastic T-shaped cable guides, a solid or a pass-through-ports chassis), and its photographs show the same form. Every figure that is not the table's is the Evolution part's and is `estimated`, with its method in the notes below. Nothing was copied from a picture; the figures are transcribed.

mount.note: estimated - NO HELD PAGE SAYS HOW A MOTIVE HORIZONTAL MANAGER MOUNTS. It is drawn as the Evolution horizontal manager is, a back plate the full 19 in EIA width that bolts to the rail face at a rack unit and stands out from it (`rack-face`), because the page prints the same 19 in by 8.2 in envelope for a manager of the same height. The `mounting` gap names what would settle it.

passes.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: the two ports are open (`cover: open`): a cable crosses the back plate through each from the front to the rear. The sizes are the ports' in `rear` above.

rear.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: THE BACK PLATE WITH ITS TWO PORTS. The data sheet's one picture of the pass-through ports (page 3, "Cable Pass-Through Ports shown", a 2U part) shows two oval ports in the back plate. Here they are 80 wide and 60 high, centred on the height, their centres 0.24 and 0.76 of the 450.0 between the ears: the 2U part's ovals read 0.45 of its height and that ratio is held. No picture or table shows this part's ports. The plate's ears are the ends of the plate; their mounting holes are not drawn.

shell.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: A SHEET BODY, NOT A BOX: the back plate as a well 206 deep whose floor is open at the two ports, the two rows of fingers standing in it, the door in it across the finger heads, which lifts off and opens the manager. The data sheet says "welded and riveted frame/door attaches to all CPI Rack Systems with supplied tool-less mounting hardware".

thickness.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: no document states a gauge. 1.5 is the steel of comparable rack-face parts in this library (the FS FHD-CMP5DR, 1.5 mm cold-rolled), since the data sheet says only "steel, aluminum, and plastic T-shaped cable guides".

top.note: the drawing of the Evolution horizontal manager of the same height and chassis style (`35441-x03` in this library), used here for the reason in `method`; its own note, in which "the data sheet" and "the pictures" are the Evolution Cable Management System data sheet's: the plan, rear at y=0: the back plate 2.0 thick, the finger plate to the door, nine slots 24.0 wide on a 45.0 pitch from 22 to 186 deep with rounded roots, narrowing to the 8.0 neck under the door's 16 mm return. Read off the data sheet pictures; no view of the maker's is orthographic.

weight.note: datasheet - 5 lb (2.4 kg) in the data sheet's ordering table (page 7): its column is SHIPPING weight, so the carton is in it and the manager itself weighs less. No net weight is stated by any document held; the figure is stated as the weight so the part has one, and is an upper bound.
